text_block_list.text:
Though the Trainer had successfully 
steered her toward sprint races so far, 
they worried whether she would run 
obediently in the next race as well.

One day, I happened upon Sakura Bakushin O 
proudly talking about her trust in me.

Hearing those feelings, the Trainer 
reaffirmed their resolve to guide her down 
a Bakushin Road where she could truly 
shine.
